description: Estimates reclaimable team capacity and an illustrative payback period from caller-supplied workload figures. Requires people, weekly hours per person and loaded hourly cost; when automatable share or working weeks are omitted, the server uses 60% and 48. Payback is calculated only when an implementation cost is supplied. Returns weekly and annual hours reclaimed, annual capacity value, payback months, the assumptions used and a recommended next step. Results are planning estimates, not guaranteed savings or financial advice.

automatableShare.description: Fraction of repetitive time that can be reclaimed (0.6 means 60%). Optional; defaults to 0.6 when omitted. An explicit value is used as given.

implementationCost.description: Implementation cost in the same currency as the hourly labor cost. Optional; when omitted, no payback estimate is calculated.

loadedHourlyCost.description: Loaded hourly labor cost in the user's stated currency, supplied by the user.

people.description: Number of people supplied by the user.

weeklyHoursPerPerson.description: Weekly hours each person spends on this workflow, supplied by the user.

workingWeeks.description: Working weeks per year, 1 to 52. Optional; defaults to 48 when omitted. An explicit value is used as given.
